since.title: Add GEN, a phrase generator
since.text: Add GEN, a phrase generator ported from Mutable Dreams 1.2 by Kid Bunka / Christoph Link (GPL-3.0-only), on two new SEQ pages after TRANSPOSE. GEN: GEN (SPARSE, ARP, PULSE, DRIFT writes the track's 64 steps from the pattern's seed, at KEY + OCT, snapped to the track's SCALE), MARB (0–100 %: off-beat notes become the root, a third, fourth or fifth; remembered per seed, position and 2-bar span), OCT, FLLW (the track follows the chord journey). GEN CHORD: CHRD (OFF, I-IV-I-V, I-VI-IV-V, I-VII-IV-I, I-III-VI-IV as scale degrees), BARS (1–8 a chord), LOCK (the variation repeats), UNDO (one level). REC on either page draws a new seed and writes the phrase again. Generated steps are ordinary steps; MARBLES and the journey change the notes as they play, never the stored steps.

since.title: Add DOR, PHR, MIN5, MAJ5
since.text: Add DOR, PHR, MIN5, MAJ5 and WHL to the track SCALE (TRANSPOSE page), after MAJ and MIN. The pattern SCALE keeps its four values.

since.title: Projects become MNM9
since.text: Projects become MNM9 (3680 bytes) and patterns version 5 (3066 bytes), adding GEN. MNM8 projects and version-four patterns load with GEN off; nothing else in them changes.

notes.title: Give MNM-1 its own stable
notes.text: Give MNM-1 its own stable USB/package identity, FM-1_61000100, so firmware hubs can distinguish it from other firmware. Sound, controls and saved-data formats are unchanged.

notes.text: Publish a GitHub release with the firmware package and a directly linked 240 × 240 screen capture.
